title: Separate dedup from catch-up
trigger: Incremental processing where new items arrive after an initial batch and a coarse guard blocks the follow-up
principle: Separate "don't redo" (dedup) from "allow new items" (catch-up). Use id-level dedup so already-processed items skip, but allow re-run so newly discovered items get processed.

cases.context: URL guard blocks subtitle catch-up because video and subtitles share the same page URL
Fresh page load should reset dedup so navigation to a new episode downloads fresh
cases.bad: // guard persists across navigations under same URL category

applyFor: Incremental processing / polling with diff (new items arrive after initial batch)
Caching with invalidation (cache by id, invalidate by key, allow new ids)
Data synchronization (sync by id, allow new items, skip already-synced)
Any pipeline where a coarse guard wrongly suppresses legitimate follow-up work
